market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are an established Premier League club with strong financial backing; they have not been relegated since 2010/11 and typically finish mid‑table. Historical data shows that teams of their stature rarely get relegated (sub‑10% chance). The market price of 34.5% implies they are one of the top favourites, which appears to be an overreaction to a mediocre 2024–25 season. Even accounting for managerial uncertainty, a true probability around 11% is more realistic.
evidence_points: West Ham have finished between 6th and 14th in recent Premier League seasons, never in serious relegation danger.
They possess a large stadium, stable revenue streams, and invest in the squad every summer.
Historical betting odds for similar mid‑table clubs imply a relegation probability well below 15% for any given season.
